description: Guided assistant that helps a US small business find and apply for commercial insurance (General Liability first): one-time intake, reusable profile, importer-aware provider matching, paste-ready answer sheets, and per-provider manual-action checklists. Guides the user through their own browser; never fills, submits, or pays.

novel_features.name: Importer-aware routing
novel_features.description: Ranks providers from a data-driven appetite registry; importers/private-label/manufacturers (deemed manufacturers) are routed to specialty markets and the mainstream instant-quote carriers that decline the class are pushed to an 'avoid' tier.

novel_features.name: Per-provider answer sheet
novel_features.description: Maps the stored profile to the exact paste-ready values for each provider's quote form, plus provider-specific hints.

novel_features.name: Manual-actions checklist
novel_features.description: Surfaces the human-only steps the tool refuses to do: CAPTCHA, account/password, EIN/SSN, payment, and the two-gate submit approval.

novel_features.name: Underwriting warnings
novel_features.description: Encodes the live-run lessons: foreign-products exclusion (the #1 importer trap), the GL Coverage B IP gap, and lead-capture/consent process traps.

novel_features.name: End-to-end guide
novel_features.description: One command that combines warnings plus per-provider URL, answer sheet, and checklist into a guided walkthrough.
